## What changed

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Architecture impact

- [ ] No architecture change.
- [ ] Architecture/docs updated and decision recorded where needed.
- [ ] Data model or event schema changed with migration/version handling.
- [ ] Security boundary, permission or secret handling changed and reviewed.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck passes.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Failure/cancellation/recovery behavior considered.
- [ ] Preview behavior is labelled as mock/simulated where applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots or logs attached when UI behavior changes.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets or personal data committed.
- [ ] Tool capabilities and approvals remain enforced.
- [ ] No unreviewed workflow permission escalation.
- [ ] Migration/upgrade impact is documented.
- [ ] User-facing claims match tested functionality.

## Release impact

- [ ] No release impact.
- [ ] Release notes / migration notes required.
- [ ] Cross-platform packaging needs verification.
